purpose: Evaluate whether the new physical gauge-invariant receiver is finite-shot useful: derive rigorous binary-error necessary and sufficient shot bounds under ideal i.i.d. samples and fixed disclosed classical uniform-response noise, retaining all pairs and the strongest known-pair quantum comparator.

owner_boundary.write_scope: research/frontier_framecost226 and dedicated workflow only; no existing owner or native financial source changes

math: For classical distributions p,q, BC=sum sqrt(p*q). Equal-prior independent N-shot minimum Bayes error is at least (1-sqrt(1-BC^(2N)))/2 and at most BC^N/2. Thus for target a=.05 the necessary N is ceil(log(4*a*(1-a))/(2*log(BC))) and sufficient N is ceil(log(2*a)/log(BC)), subject to justified numerical precision. Single-shot actual optimal error for this fixed receiver is (1-TV(p,q))/2. For source syndrome states rho_i,rho_j, the strong known-binary comparator has optimal single-copy Helstrom error (1-||rho_i-rho_j||_1/2)/2; it is not a general unknown-mixture solution. Noise fractions mix the observed p with uniform over all fixed outcomes; they are authored sensitivities, not physical calibration.

criteria.source_binding: fail on any of five pinned Git blob changes
criteria.denominators: both named fixtures and all 609 pairs in all 3 scenarios = 1827 pair-scenarios; retain zero-distance and numerically unresolved pairs
criteria.valid_probabilities: finite nonnegative, normalized probabilities and 0<=BC<=1 within tolerance
criteria.bounds: where numerically distinguishable: 1<=necessary<=sufficient and exact one-shot receiver error >= Helstrom minus 2e-8
criteria.data_processing: all pair TVs must not increase as uniform-response fraction increases; BC must not decrease except 2e-8 numerical tolerance
criteria.numerical_abstention: pairs with BC within 1e-12 of 1 or TV <=1e-9 are marked unresolved or indistinguishable, never assigned favorable finite shot counts
criteria.resource_claims: reported sample counts are mathematically bounded ideal i.i.d. shots, not measured hardware costs or dollars; CPU/wall telemetry separated
criteria.cross_process: two independently invoked same-source processes agree all pairing identities and numeric results; any failure preserved
criteria.no_deploy: no physical shot/buyer/revenue/profit/inventor gain or US$3B claim

stopping_rule: One frozen source, exactly two fixtures, three stated classical noise fractions, all 1827 pair-scenarios; no new seeds/fixtures/tolerances or samples chosen after seeing outcomes.
economics: Do not infer full cost, buyer utility, hardware realizability, cash or native profit from shot bounds. The instrument exposes a necessary hardware-feasibility dependency for the existing candidate and a NO DEPLOY decision pending measured beneficiary acceptance, device costs, capacity and strong complete alternatives.
authorization: Existing simulation-only research, standard public GitHub Actions; no spending/outreach/APIs requiring keys/production/ledger writers, PR remains draft.
